paragraphs.text: Someone heard the whole teaching, all of it, and still asks: what does the highest really look like? Even now the doubt sits there, undisplaced.
Is he nine-formed? Three-headed? A triple of powers? Is he made of sound-drops and moon-bits and wheels? The questions pile up, one on each mark.
But if the higher has something higher above it, that splits it — and the highest cannot have parts. So no letter can spell him and no body can hold him.
Then grace cuts the knot: what you asked is the teaching itself. Most hidden, yet told straight out — here is Bhairava's whole form, nothing held back.
Know him by how thin things are: the world is the eye-god's net, a dream, a city in the clouds. This picture is drawn for one reason only — so restless minds have somewhere to sit and look.

paragraphs.text: You heard all of it and you still don't get it. Same. So what does he actually look like, for real?
Nine selves? Three heads? Power cubed? Sound-drops and moon-bits and wheels? Yeah, the questions pile up.
Higher than higher breaks itself — parts can't be partless. Letters won't hold him. Bodies won't hold him.
Grace cuts through: your question was the teaching all along. Classified, but make it public — the full form, no redactions.
Proof of how unreal stuff is: god-net, dream-logic, mirage cities. This map exists for one reason — so spun-out minds have somewhere to sit.
